newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tan Chong in building products venture.
newsitem.headline: Tan Chong in building products venture.

text.p: Tan Chong Motor Holdings Bhd's subsidiary Tan Chong Industrial Equipment Sdn Bhd has entered into a joint-venture agreement with New Zealand's Structurflex Ltd to make materials for the transport, building and environment industries.
The joint-venture company, Structurflex Sdn Bhd, will have an authorised and paid-up capital of 700,000 ringgit, Tan Chong said in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Monday.
Both parties will hold an even 50 percent stake in the new company, Tan Chong said, adding that its shares would be financed from internal funds.

The joint-venture will produce, among others, fabric rods for road and rail transport, tension membrane structures for buildings and oil booms for countries in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) market.
Production is expected to commence in February, 1997, with technical assistance from Structurflex.

The project should produce "reasonable returns in the longer term, but will have no material effect on the earnings and net tangible assets of the group for the year ending December 31, 1996," Tan Chong said.
